\#\# The biggest myths surrounding ERP systems:

  

\!\[ERP myths illustration\](https://contetra.b-cdn.net/pages/services/eis/erp-cta-two.webp)

  

\#\#\# Myth

  

ERP systems are very costly

  

Most companies have a fixed notion about ERP implementation being expensive. While they're not always wrong, the assumption is not based on ground facts. The cost of ERP implementation tends to vary and is completely negotiable depending on the modules opted for, and the number of the users you require.

  

\#\#\# Myth

  

ERP system implementation is time-consuming

  

When attempted without a project plan or functional partner, it can be a daunting task. Ambitious Gantt charts might not help since finance is moving towards lean practices and agile processes. We're all about trimming wasteful activities, looking at workflows with a critical eye, adding more value to the business units with change management and automation.

  

\#\#\# Myth

  

ERP is only for large organisations

  

ERPs can and should be used by organisations of all sizes, and can be adapted to fit the specific needs of each organisation\! There are many ERP solutions designed for small and medium sized businesses. ERP can offer many benefits to organisations of all sizes, including improved efficiency, better visibility into operations, and improved customer service\!

Business Outcomes

  

\#\# Implement Microsoft ERP Around Business Outcomes

  

Investing in Microsoft Dynamics ERP software should do more than replace an old system. It should improve reporting reliability, reduce manual workarounds and create visibility across operational and financial processes.

  

\[Speak with Our Consultants →\](https://contetra.com/contact)

  

| Business Challenge | Required ERP Outcome |

| --- | --- |

| Disconnected finance and operational data | Integrated workflows and consistent reporting |

| Spreadsheet-led approvals and manual tracking | Controlled processes and workflow automation |

| Limited inventory, project or profitability visibility | Decision-ready dashboards and MIS |

| Weak master data and inconsistent processes | Standardised information and stronger controls |

  

Microsoft Ecosystem

  

\#\# 7 Microsoft ERP Applications & Connected Tools to Evaluate

  

Not every organisation needs the same ERP architecture. A growing business may begin with an MS Business Central implementation, while a manufacturer may have a broader Microsoft FnO ERP requirement.

  

| Microsoft Application | Best Suited For | Core Business Use |

| --- | --- | --- |

| Dynamics 365 Business Central | Growing small and midsize businesses | Finance, purchasing, sales, inventory, service and selected manufacturing |

| Dynamics 365 Finance | Mid-market and enterprise organisations | Financial control, budgeting, reporting and multi-entity visibility |

| Dynamics 365 Supply Chain | Manufacturers and distributors | Procurement, planning, production, inventory and warehousing |

| Dynamics 365 Project Operations | Consulting and project-led businesses | Projects, resources, billing and profitability |

| Dynamics 365 Commerce | Retail and ecommerce businesses | Omnichannel operations, transactions and fulfilment |

| Microsoft Power BI | CFOs and management teams | MIS dashboards, KPIs and profitability reporting |

| Microsoft Power Platform | Teams requiring workflow automation | Approvals, process extensions and low-code applications |

  

\\\\\* Power BI and Power Platform are connected Microsoft tools that strengthen reporting and automation around an ERP environment; they are not standalone ERP applications.

  

Business Need

  

Financial reporting

  

Chart of accounts, dimensions, controls and MIS design

  

Inventory and procurement

  

Item masters, purchase planning and stock visibility

  

Sales and fulfilment

  

Order-to-cash workflows and reconciliation

  

Management insight

  

Power BI-ready data and performance dashboards

  

Business Central ERP

  

\#\# Connected Finance and Operations with Microsoft Business Central ERP

  

For businesses moving away from basic accounting tools, fragmented systems or Excel-led operations, Microsoft Business Central ERP can connect finance, purchasing, sales, inventory, services and management reporting.

  

A successful Microsoft Business Central ERP project is not limited to software configuration. It should address process fit, master data, approvals, reporting design, testing, training and post-go-live adoption.

  

\[Start Your BC Project →\](https://contetra.com/contact)

Odoo Modules

  

\#\# Odoo ERP Modules Businesses Can Evaluate

  

The right Odoo ERP requirement depends on your operating model, industry, scale and reporting needs. Implement only the applications that solve relevant process problems.

  

| Odoo Functional Area | Relevant Business Need |

| --- | --- |

| Accounting & Finance | Invoicing, accounting workflows, receivables, payables and reporting |

| CRM & Sales | Lead management, quotations, sales orders and customer visibility |

| Purchase & Inventory | Vendor processes, procurement, warehouse tracking and stock control |

| Manufacturing | Production planning, material requirements, work orders and costing visibility |

| Projects & Services | Tasks, timesheets, project billing and delivery tracking |

| Ecommerce & POS | Retail or online sales connected with inventory and finance |

| HR & Employee Operations | Employee workflows, expenses and related processes |

Functional Expertise

  

\#\# Why Functional Consulting Matters in Odoo Implementation

  

Odoo is flexible and modular, but that flexibility must be managed carefully. Poorly planned implementation can lead to unnecessary customisation, unreliable data, weak reporting, difficult upgrades and users returning to spreadsheets.

  

As an Odoo expert in functional ERP planning, process alignment and finance-led system design, Contetra helps businesses focus on measurable outcomes rather than software configuration alone.

  

\[Talk to an Odoo Consultant →\](https://contetra.com/contact)

  

Key Decision Areas

  

Module selection

  

Which applications solve the real business requirement?

  

Process design

  

Which existing workflows should be simplified or standardised?

  

Data readiness

  

What master data and opening information must be cleaned before migration?

  

Customisation

  

What is genuinely needed beyond standard configuration?

  

Reporting

  

Which MIS reports, controls and dashboards are required from day one?

  

Adoption

  

How will business users be trained and supported after go-live?

  

Industry Fit

  

\#\# Odoo ERP Solutions for Different Business Models

  

The right implementation scope should reflect transaction volume, operational complexity, reporting expectations and management priorities.

  

| Business Type | Relevant Odoo Focus Areas |

| --- | --- |

| Manufacturing Businesses | Purchase, inventory, manufacturing, quality, costing and finance visibility |

| Distribution & Trading | Procurement, sales, warehouses, inventory tracking and reporting |

| Retail & Ecommerce Brands | POS, ecommerce, inventory, sales, customer workflows and accounting |

| Professional Services Firms | CRM, projects, timesheets, billing, collections and profitability |

| Multi-Department Companies | Finance, CRM, purchase, inventory, approvals and management reporting |

Partner Selection

  

\#\# Choosing an Odoo Partner for Long-Term Success

  

When shortlisting an Odoo partner, businesses should look beyond platform familiarity. The right consulting team should understand operational processes, data risks, reporting needs and post-go-live support.

  

| Evaluation Area | What to Review |

| --- | --- |

| Functional capability | Experience across the Odoo modules relevant to your business |

| Industry understanding | Familiarity with workflows similar to your operating model |

| Migration approach | Method for cleaning, mapping and reconciling business data |

| Customisation discipline | Ability to avoid unnecessary development and upgrade complications |

| Reporting expertise | Understanding of MIS, controls, margins, inventory and financial visibility |

| Support model | Training, hypercare, issue resolution and ongoing optimisation |

  

Client Results

  

\#\# Odoo ERP Outcomes Across Industries

  

Pipe Manufacturing

  

Streamlined Operations for a Pipe Manufacturer

  

Challenge

  

Legacy ERP systems created inefficiencies across manufacturing, inventory, purchase, accounting and quality control.

  

Solution

  

Odoo modules for manufacturing, PLM, QC, inventory, sales, purchase, accounting and reporting were implemented.

  

✓

  

Improved manufacturing tracking, stronger inventory visibility, integrated workflows and automated quality checks.

  

E-commerce Platform

  

Optimised Warehouse Operations for a Leading E-commerce Business

  

Challenge

  

Outdated ERP processes caused order fulfilment delays, weak inventory visibility and system performance issues.

  

Solution

  

Migrated to Odoo Enterprise with sales, purchase, inventory, barcode and accounting modules, with priority-based warehouse allocation.

  

✓

  

Faster order fulfilment, better warehouse efficiency, reduced downtime and improved scalability during peak order volumes.

  

Insurance Company

  

CRM & Subscription Management for an Insurance Business

  

Challenge

  

Dispersed customer data, inefficient subscription management, commission issues and limited real-time policy tracking.

  

Solution

  

Odoo CRM and subscription management implemented to centralise customer data, policies, claims and renewal workflows.

  

✓

  

Improved customer engagement, automated renewals, real-time policy tracking and streamlined commission calculation.

  

Retail & Wholesale Business

  

Streamlined Retail and Wholesale Operations with POS

  

Challenge

  

Scattered data, inefficient stock transfers, negative stock issues and inaccurate financial records affected daily operations.

  

Solution

  

Odoo 17 implemented with inventory, POS, automated journal entries and asset management modules.

  

✓

  

Centralised data access, automated item transfers, accurate landed-cost calculation, customised reporting and improved stock control.

  

Common Questions

  

\#\# FAQs on Odoo ERP Implementation

  

Everything you need to know about Odoo ERP implementation and choosing Contetra as your Odoo implementation partner.

  

\[Ask Us Directly →\](https://contetra.com/contact)

  

What is Odoo ERP?

  

Odoo is a modular suite of business applications that can support accounting, CRM, sales, purchase, inventory, manufacturing, ecommerce, projects, point of sale and other operational processes.

  

Who should consider Odoo ERP?

  

Growing businesses requiring integrated operations, improved reporting, stronger inventory or process control, and reduced reliance on spreadsheets may consider Odoo based on their business requirements.

  

Why is an Odoo functional consultant important?

  

An Odoo functional consultant helps map business requirements to modules, workflows, approvals, reports, migration needs and user responsibilities, reducing the risk of an implementation that does not fit actual operations.

  

What does Odoo Data migration involve?

  

Odoo Data migration may include master-data cleanup, field mapping, opening balances, customer and vendor information, inventory data, validation and reconciliation before system use.

  

How long does an Odoo ERP implementation take?

  

The timeline depends on modules, locations, users, data quality, integrations, customisation, testing and training requirements. A focused implementation is generally faster than a multi-function or manufacturing-led rollout.

  

How should a business select an Odoo service provider?

  

Evaluate relevant module experience, industry understanding, migration methodology, customisation approach, reporting capability, testing support, training and post-go-live optimisation.

  

Odoo ERP Implementation

\#\# Looking for a game changing approach?

  

Let me introduce youto contractual staffing. It's all aboutflexibility, cost-effectiveness, and efficiencywhen it comes to finding top-notch talent.

  

This is the secret sauce to meet your hiring needs while staying within timelines and budgets. (Plus, it's a great way to boost your retention rates)

  

\!\[Contractual staffing: professionals agreeing on a contract with supporting documentation\](https://contetra.b-cdn.net/pages/services/frc/frc-cta-2.png)

  

\#\#\# Flexibility and Scalability

  

Temp staffing allows for scaling up or down resources based on project demands and seasonal fluctuations such as year-end closures, ensuring optimal resource allocation.

  

\#\#\# Cost Efficiency

  

Temp staffing eliminates the long-term financial commitments associated with hiring permanent employees, such as salaries, benefits, and recruitment expenses. Organizations can allocate their budget more efficiently and reduce overhead costs.

  

\#\#\# Targeted Expertise

  

Temporary professionals bring focused finance knowledge and experience, providing immediate value and contributing to the successful execution of projects.

  

\#\#\# Trial Period

  

Temp staffing offers a trial period to evaluate a candidate's performance and cultural fit before making a long-term commitment. This minimizes the risk of hiring mismatches and allows for a better assessment of candidates' skills and compatibility with the finance team and organizational culture.

  

\#\#\# Rapid Onboarding

  

Temporary professionals are often experienced in quickly adapting to new environments and projects. They require minimal training and onboarding time, allowing finance teams to seamlessly integrate them into ongoing initiatives and maximize productivity from the start.

  

When it comes to Finance roles, it'sQuality\>Quantity& we've got the talent pool to enhance your team's capabilities\!

Instead of trying to manage everything yourself, why not call in the experts? Read our short guide for why companies should outsource their accounting function\!

  

Tldr; Complete control. Measurable KPIs. Zero time lost in training staff. Full Accountability.

  

\[Find out how you can transform your accounting challenges into opportunities.\](https://contetra.com/turbocharge-your-finance-function-through-offshore-accounting)

  

\#\#\# Cha-Ching: Instant Cost Savings

  

Outsourcing your accounting and bookkeeping services can \*\*save you money and streamline your financial operations.\*\* Hiring an in-house team comes with added expenses (such as salary cost, retirement benefits, training costs, infrastructure support, etc.). Standardizing your accounting processes creates consistency and accuracy, and annual agreements allow for flexibility and performance evaluation.

  

\#\#\# Grow Well: Sustainable Scalability

  

Outsourcing provides the \*\*flexibility to scale the accounting functions up or down based on needs.\*\* This allows firms to efficiently manage fluctuations in their accounting workloads, particularly during seasonal changes in demand. As a result, there is necessary flexibility to achieve optimal operational efficiency while ensuring they meet their financial obligations.

  

\#\#\# Show me the money: ROI-driven Approach

  

When you outsource with the right partner, \*\*the output is more tangible, measurable, and tailored to specific requirements, with clear time-bound deliverables that can be easily tracked.\*\* That means clearer accountability, predictable outcomes, and a finance function aligned to business priorities.

  

\#\#\# Access to Expertise

  

Finding and retaining top-notch candidates for financial reporting positions is not easy. Offshore accounting outsourcing presents a golden opportunity to tap into a \*\*pool of experts with a wealth of combined experience spanning several decades.\*\* This extensive expertise is vital to keeping up with the ever-changing business landscape while staying ahead of the competition and complying with relevant regulations.

\#\# What Is the MCA Schedule III Struck Off Disclosure Requirement?

  

In April 2021, The MCA introduced a brand-new regulation wherein companies must disclose details of transactions with the companies that are struck off by the MCA under the Companies Act.

  

The details to be disclosed are:

  

\!\[\](https://contetra.b-cdn.net/pages/services/st/strike-that-check-icon.png)

  

Name of the Struck-Off company.

  

\!\[\](https://contetra.b-cdn.net/pages/services/st/strike-that-check-icon.png)

  

Nature of transactions with such company.

  

\!\[\](https://contetra.b-cdn.net/pages/services/st/strike-that-check-icon.png)

  

Balance outstanding and relationship with the struck-off company.

\#\# FAQ

  

\#\#\# What do you mean by Struck off company?

  

A Struck off company means the company is no longer operational and it is removed from the list of registered companies.

\#\# Who we are

  

A bunch ofex-Big 4 consultantsand formerindustry veteranswho are aware of the latest updates to the accounting standards,

  

have hands-on audit experience and want to make sure you have a smooth financial statement closure process\!

  

A bunch ofex-Big 4 consultantsand formerindustry veteranswho are aware of the latest updates to the accounting standards,  have hands-on audit experience and want to make sure you have a smooth financial statement closure process\!

  

We ensure that your team’s bandwidth (yes, that favourite word of the finance team) isn’t choked on account of \*\*continuous changes to financial statements\*\* and frequent discussions with auditors. We’ll gladly take that on.

  

Because of bandwidth constraints (yes, that word again\!), we’ve noticed that finance teams are generally \*\*unable to challenge even the unmeritorious requests from auditors.\*\* And more so, once the position is taken, it is expected to be followed in subsequent years. Well, not on our watch\!

  

\*\*Complex technical accounting issues\*\*, end to end preparation of financial statements and creation of technical accounting memos is our area of expertise. So you can be assured of the collective wisdom of former Big-4 auditors and senior industry controllers\!

  

Most importantly – \*\*how do we help you sleep better?\*\* By handling the entire financial statement preparation, engaging with auditors for clearing queries, building documentation & memos around complex accounting positions, and dealing with any modifications and technical positions considered in the financials.

With a dedicated team of former auditors and industry veterans, we’ll enable effective business

With a dedicated team of former auditors and industry veterans, we’ll enable effective business partnering by taking over preparation of financial statements, liaising with auditors for speedy closures and ensuring number sanity for management reporting.

  

\#\#\# You’re all set to leap for scale

  

Our technical accounting resources provide a full spectrum of technical accounting services. If you're poised to scale, we make sure critical functions, data points and accounting processes aren't holding you back by taking up hundreds of productive hours.

  

\#\#\# You’re free to keep a hawk-eye on business

  

We set up a culture of \*\*process excellence\*\*, within the financial reporting function, with a focus on presence and structuring the financial statements to demonstrate maximum value to stakeholders, leaving you with the time to focus on what matters.

  

\#\#\# You can leave it to the experts

  

With global accounting standards (IFRS & US GAAP) becoming the most-spoken languages in the world, our resources are fluent in international GAAP and F\&A from a \*\*practical stand-point\*\* having worked across geographies, industries and sectors.

  

\#\# How we work

  

\!\[Complete ownership workflow for technical accounting support\](https://contetra.b-cdn.net/pages/services/taigas/taigas-complete-ownership.png)

  

We approach the project as follows:

  

\#\#\# Preparation of Trial Balance andAccount Reconciliation Support:

  

Understanding closure process for key areas and potential challenges, direct & indirect Tax Positions. Recommendations on course of action regarding previous statutory & internal audit observations. Preparedness review of estimates and data room structure.

  

\#\#\# IPO Financial Reporting and GAAP Advisory Support

  

Impact assessment of key standards with quantifiable aspects. Preparation of financial statements for the year as per Ind AS/IFRS/US GAAP, which shall include the Statement of Financial Position, Statement of Profit and Loss and Other Comprehensive Income, Statement of Cash Flows, Statement of Changes in Equity for the period, Notes to accounts, Comparatives and opening balance sheet of previous period.

  

\!\[Step-by-step technical accounting process stack illustration\](https://contetra.b-cdn.net/pages/services/taigas/taigas-rank.png)

  

\#\#\# Period Closure Support:

  

Creation & review of every aspect of the financial statements, assessing key contracts where needed, technical positions where accounting memos are needed to substantiate positions, and preparing workings for quantifying financial impact. Review of GAAP adjustments, tax provision and deferred taxes computation.

  

\#\#\# Audit and Compliance Supportfor Growing Finance Teams:

  

Getting auditor buy-in on all key positions considered in the financial statements. Assisting management during the audit in non document related matters (analytics, justifications, areas involving estimates, assumptions, projections, how to go about preparing various disclosures).

\#\# Contetra Privacy Policy

\# Privacy Policy

  

Thank you for showing interest in Contetra (Contetra Private Limited, "we" or "us") and using this website. We value the trust and confidence you place in us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, process, and protect your information.

  

This Privacy Policy applies only to this website and does not apply to third-party websites, products, mobile apps, or services, even if linked from our website. We recommend reviewing the privacy policies of such third parties separately.

  

\#\# 1\\. Consent and Scope

  

\- By using this website, you agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy.

\- You expressly consent to the processing of your personal information in accordance with this policy.

\- Your data may be stored, processed, or transferred in India or other countries where data protection laws may differ.

\- If you do not agree with this policy, please do not use or access this website.

  

\#\# 2\\. Information We Collect

  

We may collect one or more of the following categories of information:

  

\- \*\*Personal identity information:\*\* such as age, gender, marital status, preferences, likes/dislikes, and similar details.

\- \*\*Social profile information:\*\* if you connect via Facebook (where applicable), publicly available profile data.

\- \*\*Payment and account information:\*\* billing history, payment history, and account communications.

\- \*\*Service usage data:\*\* website navigation behavior, referring pages, and resource interaction data.

\- \*\*Log information:\*\* IP address, browser type/language, web request details, and date/time of access.

\- \*\*Correspondence information:\*\* communication content and metadata across channels such as email, forums, blogs, and messaging tools.

\- \*\*User IDs and security data:\*\* usernames, passwords, email addresses, and related authentication details.

\- \*\*Stored information:\*\* files or data stored on our systems (for example, documents or images).

  

\#\# 3\\. How and Why We Use Information

  

\- To conduct our business and provide, maintain, and improve our services.

\- To manage our relationship with you, including service delivery and account support.

\- To share relevant updates, product information, promotions, and schemes, where appropriate.

\- To generate aggregated statistical and demographic insights for business and marketing analysis.

  

We do not sell or trade your personal information. We disclose personal information only as described in this policy, or with your prior written consent where required.

  

\#\# 4\\. Public Forums and Open Environments

  

Any information you voluntarily submit in public forums (including blogs, communities, and discussion boards) is not confidential, may not be treated as personal information, and is not protected under this Privacy Policy.

  

\#\# 5\\. Exceptions and Legal Disclosures

  

We may intercept, monitor, store, or disclose personal information when required:

  

\- By law or legal process.

\- To operate our business and provide services.

\- To secure our systems and protect users.

\- To enforce our legal rights or Terms of Service.

  

Such actions may occur without prior notice where permitted by law. We may also use third-party service providers where necessary and share relevant personal information strictly for service delivery purposes.

  

\#\# 6\\. Data Protection and Security Practices

  

\- \*\*Strict data usage policy:\*\* client data is used only for agreed contractual purposes.

\- \*\*Advanced safeguards:\*\* firewalls, encryption, and multi-factor authentication are used to protect data.

\- \*\*Regular backups:\*\* data is backed up to support recoverability during unforeseen incidents.

\- \*\*Testing and audits:\*\* backup and security processes are regularly reviewed against industry standards.

\- \*\*Disaster recovery:\*\* procedures are in place for data recovery, system restoration, and business continuity.

\- \*\*Skilled technical team:\*\* trained teams respond quickly to data loss or corruption incidents.

  

\#\# 7\\. Changes to This Privacy Policy

  

This Privacy Policy may be revised from time to time without prior notice. We recommend reviewing it periodically to stay informed of any updates. Continued use of the website indicates acceptance of the revised policy, until consent is expressly withdrawn by the user.

  

\#\# 8\\. Contact Us

  

For questions or concerns related to this Privacy Policy, please email \[info@contetra.com\](mailto:info@contetra.com).

  

\#\# Terms of Service

\# Terms and Conditions

  

\#\# 1\\. Content Disclaimer

  

Contetra Private Limited may communicate content provided by advertisers, partners, publishers, employees, users, resellers, and other third parties. While we make reasonable efforts to maintain quality, we do not guarantee the authenticity, accuracy, completeness, legality, copyright compliance, or currency of such content.

  

\- Materials may contain typographical or technical errors and may change without notice.

\- Product, service, promotion, pricing, and availability details are subject to change by the relevant provider.

\- We reserve the right to correct errors, update information, and make improvements to the platforms at our sole discretion.

\- Your use of content is at your own discretion and risk.

  

\#\# 2\\. Intellectual Property and Usage Restrictions

  

All rights, title, and interest, including trademarks and copyrights in platform content, are reserved by Contetra Private Limited.

  

\- Users may read, print, or download material for personal use only.

\- Unauthorized reproduction, redistribution, transmission, or commercial use (in whole or part) is strictly prohibited.

  

\#\# 3\\. External Links and Third-Party Content

  

Our platforms may include links to third-party websites as a convenience. Such links do not imply endorsement. We are not responsible for the availability, functionality, safety, legality, or content of external websites.

  

\- Access to third-party sites may direct you outside systems controlled by Contetra.

\- External content may be objectionable, inaccurate, or non-compliant; use of such content is at your own risk.

\- We may disable links to and from third-party sites at any time, without obligation.

  

\#\# 4\\. Training and ACCA Partnership: Refund and Cancellation

  

\- Once a participant pays more than 50% of course fees, no refund is normally offered.

\- Exceptional personal emergency cases may be evaluated on a case-by-case basis.

\- Enrollment cancellation or refund requests must be emailed to \[info@contetra.com\](mailto:info@contetra.com).

\- Course transfers are generally not allowed after enrollment, except in approved exceptional cases.

\- Course pricing is as listed on the relevant course/brochure page.

  

\#\# 5\\. Complaint Logging Process

  

If service falls below acceptable standards, please send complaint details by email to \[info@contetra.com\](mailto:info@contetra.com).

  

Please include your full name, issue description, and identifying details (for example, ACCA registration number or IFRS batch dates).

  

Once a complaint is received, we will:

  

\- Maintain confidentiality of submitted information.

\- Respond within 48 hours of complaint receipt.

\- Escalate and investigate through the management team.

  

For ACCA-related matters, students may escalate through institutional and ACCA complaint procedures as applicable. Reference: \[ACCA complaint escalation page\](https://www.accaglobal.com/gb/en/footertoolbar/contact-us/connect/unhappy.html).

  

\#\# 6\\. Warranty Disclaimer

  

The platforms and all materials are provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis, without warranties of any kind (express, implied, or statutory), including merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, non-infringement, security, reliability, or timeliness.

  

\- We do not verify or endorse all products/services promoted by third parties.

\- We do not guarantee that defects or errors will be corrected.

\- We do not guarantee that content is free of viruses or harmful components.

\- Certain jurisdictions may not permit exclusion of implied warranties.

  

\#\# 7\\. Limitation of Liability

  

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Contetra Private Limited is not liable for direct, indirect, incidental, consequential, special, or punitive damages (including loss of data, profits, revenue, or property) arising from use, misuse, reliance on, or inability to use the platforms or materials, even if advised of the possibility of such damages.

  

\#\# 8\\. Third-Party Transactions

  

Any correspondence, business dealings, or transactions with third-party advertisers/service providers are solely between you and that third party. We are not responsible for loss, damages, or disputes arising from such dealings.

  

\#\# 9\\. Indemnification

  

You agree to indemnify and hold harmless Contetra Private Limited, its affiliates, officers, directors, employees, and agents against claims, liabilities, losses, and expenses (including reasonable legal fees) resulting from your breach of these Terms, violation of applicable law, or infringement of third-party rights.

  

\#\# 10\\. Miscellaneous and Governing Law

  

\- These Terms are governed by the laws of India, and you submit to jurisdiction in India.

\- If any provision is found unenforceable, the remaining provisions remain valid.

\- These Terms constitute the entire agreement regarding the subject matter.

\- We reserve the right to investigate violations and seek all available legal remedies.

  

\#\# 11\\. Notices

  

Notices must be in writing and are deemed served through certified post, overnight courier, confirmed facsimile, or confirmed email. Notices to Contetra may be sent to:

  

Contetra Private Limited, 165, Satra Plaza, Palm Beach Road, Sector 19D, Vashi, Navi Mumbai - 400703, India.

  

\#\# 12\\. Force Majeure and Arbitration

  

We are not liable for delay or failure caused by events beyond reasonable control (including natural disasters, strikes, riots, network/power failures, or governmental action). Payment obligations continue during force majeure events.

  

Disputes shall be resolved under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, in English, with venue in Mumbai, India.

  

\#\# 13\\. Your Consent

  

By using the website and/or providing your information, you consent to collection and use of information in accordance with our policies. Policy updates will be posted on this page.

\## Source: https://contetra.com/erp/erpnext

\# ERPNext Implementation Services

Implement ERPNext around finance control, operational visibility and decision-ready reporting.

Contetra helps growing businesses plan, implement and optimise ERPNext through process mapping, ERP scope definition, module planning, BRD preparation, data readiness, UAT support, reporting design and post-go-live improvement.

\## Why Growing Businesses Need ERPNext Implementation

Many businesses start with Excel, Tally, standalone billing tools, disconnected inventory systems or manual approval trackers. These systems may work in the early stage, but they begin to break when transactions, locations, products, teams and reporting needs increase.

ERPNext implementation should not be treated only as a software setup. It should be designed around business workflows, financial controls, reporting expectations and user adoption.

A successful ERPNext implementation should help the business: Reduce manual dependency. Improve finance and inventory visibility. Standardise workflows. Strengthen approval controls. Track profitability better. Improve month-end reporting. Build a single source of truth for decision-making.

\## ERPNext Modules and Industries Supported

Key Modules: Accounting and Finance (General ledger, AP, AR, payments, taxes, financial statements and reporting). Sales and CRM (Leads, opportunities, quotations, sales orders, customer management). Purchase and Procurement (Purchase requests, POs, supplier management, goods receipts). Inventory and Stock (Item masters, stock movements, warehouses, batches, serial numbers, valuation). Manufacturing (BOM, work orders, production planning, job cards, WIP, material consumption). Projects (Project tracking, tasks, timesheets, billing, profitability). HR and Payroll (Employee data, attendance, payroll, leave, expense claims). Asset Management (Fixed assets, depreciation, maintenance, tracking). Reporting and Dashboards (MIS, operational reports, finance reports, management visibility).

Industries: Manufacturing. Pharma and Chemicals. Trading and Distribution. Textiles and Garments. IT and Professional Services. Retail and Ecommerce. Real Estate and Projects. Education and Training. Multi-location SMEs.

\## What Contetra Delivers in ERPNext Implementation

ERP Scope and ROI Audit: Review current systems, pain points, process gaps, expected benefits and ROI opportunities. Business Requirement Document: Document functional requirements before implementation begins. Process Mapping: Map current and future workflows across finance, procurement, inventory, sales, manufacturing, projects and reporting. Module Fitment: Identify which ERPNext modules are required and what should be implemented first. Chart of Accounts and Dimensions Review: Structure financial data for MIS, cost centres, profit centres and reporting needs. Master Data Readiness: Review item, customer and vendor masters, BOMs, opening balances and stock data. Data Migration Support: Support migration planning, validation and reconciliation expectations. UAT and Issue Tracking: Help business users test workflows, document issues and coordinate closure. Vendor and Technical Team Coordination: Bridge the gap between business teams and ERPNext technical implementers. MIS and Dashboard Design: Define reports, KPIs, dashboards and management visibility requirements. Post-Go-Live Optimisation: Improve adoption, reduce Excel dependency and stabilise business processes after go-live.

\## ERPNext Case Studies

NISPL – Unified ERP for Manufacturing Operations: A filtration manufacturing business needed better control across finance, inventory, manufacturing, CRM and HRMS. Contetra supported ERPNext planning across operational workflows, reporting needs and module-level requirements to improve visibility and process discipline.

LA Technologies – Project and Service Business ERP Structure: A service-led technology business needed better visibility across projects, services, faculty management, CRM activities and profitability. Contetra structured requirements around project tracking, billing, resource utilisation and management reporting.

Harissons Bags – Manufacturing, Inventory and Quality Control: A manufacturing business required better control over in-house production, outsourced processes, BOM, WIP, inventory and quality workflows.

CGR Metalloys – Multi-Location Refining and Inventory Control: A precious metals business needed structured workflows across labs, refinery operations, inventory movement and finance reporting.

Ajanta Bottles – Sales, Inventory and Reporting Visibility: A growing trading and distribution business needed stronger customer, inventory, sales and management reporting visibility.

\## Why Choose Contetra for ERPNext

Finance-led ERP approach — ERPNext is structured around financial control, MIS and decision-making. Strong process understanding — Better workflows across finance, procurement, inventory, sales, manufacturing and projects. BRD and documentation discipline — Clear scope reduces confusion, rework and unnecessary customisation. Cross-industry experience — Practical understanding of manufacturing, services, trading, pharma, retail and distribution. Data and reporting focus — Cleaner master data, better dimensions and stronger MIS visibility. Vendor coordination support — Better communication between business users and technical implementers. Post-go-live optimisation — Helps stabilise adoption and reduce spreadsheet dependency.

Contact: https://contetra.com/contact-us — Schedule an ERP Scope and ROI Audit.


\## Source: https://contetra.com/erp/zoho

\# Zoho ERP Implementation Services

Implement Zoho ERP around finance control, operational visibility and decision-ready reporting.

Contetra helps growing businesses plan, implement and optimise Zoho ERP through process mapping, ERP scope definition, module planning, BRD preparation, data readiness, UAT support, reporting design and post-go-live improvement.

\## Why Growing Businesses Need the Right Zoho ERP Implementation Strategy

Many businesses start with Excel, Tally, standalone billing tools, disconnected CRM systems, manual inventory records or scattered approval workflows. These systems may work in the early stage, but they begin to break when transaction volumes, teams, locations, customers and reporting needs increase.

Zoho ERP can help businesses connect finance, sales, CRM, inventory, procurement, projects, HR, analytics and automation into one integrated business environment.

A successful Zoho ERP implementation should help the business: Reduce manual dependency. Improve finance and sales visibility. Standardise approval workflows. Strengthen inventory and order tracking. Improve customer and collections visibility. Build MIS and dashboard-ready data. Support faster management decision-making.

\## Zoho ERP Modules and Industries Supported

Key Modules: Zoho Books (Accounting, invoicing, receivables, payables, taxes, banking and financial reporting). Zoho Inventory (Inventory, warehouses, stock movement, order fulfilment, shipping and stock reports). Zoho CRM (Leads, opportunities, customer management, sales pipeline and sales visibility). Zoho Projects (Project planning, tasks, timesheets, billing support and project tracking). Zoho People (Employee data, HR workflows, attendance, leave and employee operations). Zoho Expense (Expense claims, approvals, reimbursement workflows and cost control). Zoho Analytics (MIS dashboards, KPI reporting, profitability views and management reporting). Zoho Creator (Custom workflows, business apps, approvals and process automation). Zoho Flow (App integrations, workflow automation and cross-system connectivity). Zoho Desk (Customer support, ticketing, service workflows and customer experience tracking).

Industries: Trading and Distribution. Retail and Ecommerce. Professional Services. Manufacturing SMEs. IT and Technology Businesses. Consulting and Agencies. Multi-location SMEs. Service Businesses.

\## What Contetra Delivers in Zoho ERP Implementation

ERP Scope and ROI Audit. Business Requirement Document. Process Mapping across finance, sales, inventory, purchase, CRM, projects, HR and reporting. Module Fitment — Identify the right Zoho applications based on business needs and growth plans. Chart of Accounts and Reporting Review. Master Data Readiness. Zoho Data Migration Support. UAT and Issue Tracking. Vendor and Technical Team Coordination. MIS and Dashboard Design. Post-Go-Live Optimisation.

\## Zoho ERP Case Study

Pharmaceutical Trading Company — End-to-End Zoho Books and Zoho Inventory Implementation: A pharmaceutical trading company dealing in active and non-active pharmaceutical ingredients required a more scalable ERP platform. The existing Tally-based environment lacked batch-level inventory traceability, shipment-wise profitability reporting, structured purchase order management, approval workflows, and comprehensive visibility into pending receivables and payables.

Contetra implemented Zoho Books and Zoho Inventory as an integrated business solution including end-to-end system configuration, batch-level inventory tracking, approval workflows for purchase orders and manual journals, customised purchase order and invoice templates, automated bank feed integration, and structured bulk upload utilities.

Business Value Delivered: Batch-level inventory traceability across the complete supply chain. Profitability visibility by shipment and product line. Streamlined three-way matching between Purchase Orders, Goods Receipts, and Invoices. Real-time dashboards for pending receivables and payables. Faster and more accurate bank reconciliation through automated bank feeds. Reduced manual data entry using validated bulk upload templates. Improved operational controls, procurement governance, and reporting visibility.

An Odoo ERP project should not be treated only as software configuration. It should be planned around business processes, reporting needs, financial controls, data quality, user adoption and measurable ROI.

A successful Odoo implementation should help the business: Reduce spreadsheet dependency. Improve finance and inventory visibility. Standardise approval workflows.
